metadata.title: Proof-of-Policy (PoP): policy zero-knowledge proofs for LLM agent responses
metadata.description: Proof-of-Policy (PoP) proves that a delivered LLM agent response T satisfies a public policy pi without exposing the violating content; violations are disclosed only through evidence commitments. The artifact covers the Python reference layer and the certificate/verification chain (policy compilation, salted policy commitment, Ed25519-signed certificates, append-only ledger, third-party verify_session). Reproduction scope: the Docker image runs 42 pure-Python tests; on a host, scripts/ops/reproduce_artifact.sh runs demo_all.sh in fast mode (host checks, no SP1 proof) and then verify_session.py. NOT covered: groth16/compressed proving, real-LLM guessability k, and cloud-scale matrices. Every number in this record must correspond to the git commit below and to a specific result file in the repository (for example bench/results/proofs.md, bench/results/compressed.md, bench/results/compose.md, bench/results/semantic.md), with the machine and proof_mode stated. Do not compare numbers across machines or proof modes as if they were the same table. This template intentionally contains no DOI: Zenodo assigns the DOI at publication time, and it must be filled in afterwards.
